name: m3_CharCall14ED520
notes: Find the character type for a kind in the type table (first kind 2, negative ends it) and call its +0x14 handler

name: m3_CharCall1CED590
notes: Same type lookup, calls the +0x1C handler

name: m3_CharPathEE080
notes: Walk the type table (result unused), then format host0:data/char/%s into the buffer; do-while with a volatile walk pointer keeps the loop

name: m3_FxAttachF4280
notes: Play effect 0x3B2 at the object position, then attach it in mode 3 or 4; volatile store in each branch keeps both calls

name: m3_BroadcastE4050
notes: Send three values to every node of a target set (kind 1 player, kind 3 a group of 0x150-byte lists, else a record lookup); goto keeps the single lookup call

name: m3_AiSpin138270
notes: AI state entry: state from flag bits, spin rate 1.5 or 2 degrees per frame unit and its negative, flags 0x20 and 0x400000, attach mode 10

name: m3_ApplyLightEAD50
notes: Apply a light record: position with w 1 and byte colour as floats, passed with the id to 0xE43D0

name: m3_CylOverlapA2890
notes: Cylinder overlap test: horizontal distance against summed radii, then the height spans

name: m3_AnimResetC6AA0
notes: Release the attached node and reset the record fields (scale 1, speed 0.5, unit w vectors)

name: m3_ObjReleaseF42C0
notes: Release an active object: stop the stream and the camera's pending sound, detach it, mark it inactive, remove its kind 5 and 0xD components

name: m3_AiStopF15B0
notes: Stop the AI (velocity rate*0, counters cleared), touch its kind 5 component, play a cue unless game mode is 4 or 5; hangs on null

name: m3_ModeSetupAAC10
notes: Fill a 3-int setting for a mode, then set camera flag 3 from story bit 0xCA and the current event (12, 0x22)

name: m3_BoneFxC53B0
notes: Start effect 0x24 at a bone of the held model, lowered by 18 units

name: m3_ModeSetupB7EE0
notes: Mode setup for a 2-int setting; a setting of 10 syncs slot 2 with story bit 0xC0

name: m3_SpawnRandomA9340
notes: Pick a random enemy kind from a small table (0x17 becomes 3 or 4 unless 0x420090 is set) and spawn it at the origin; volatile store in one branch keeps both rand calls

name: m3_AiIdleWait138640
notes: AI idle entry: flag updates, then a random wait (1..2 for kinds 11 and 6, else 8..10 or 5..8)

name: m3_ComboTickE5B70
notes: Add to the combo counter unless locked, clamp at the maximum and fire stat 0x42 plus a stage event, then play the next of four tips when the tip timer runs out

name: m3_ApplyLight2EA930
notes: Apply a two-colour light record: byte colours as floats and the millisecond time scaled to seconds, passed to 0xE1570

name: m3_AttachPlaceC6D50
notes: Place the attached body: copy the position, build its matrix from X and Y rotation and uniform scale, translate and copy it out

name: m3_SpawnFromRecEAEE0
notes: Spawn an object from a spawn record (position and yaw), start it in its mode and store it in the owner's slot table

name: m3_PointToFrameEE3B0
notes: Transform a point record by a frame's normalised axes plus origin (or copy it without a frame), set w 1 and copy the id

name: m3_BossHomeVelCBD60
notes: Aim the boss from its target to its home point: velocity = direction * distance/30*3, acceleration = direction * -(that*0.02)

name: m3_SoulPickupA9B80
notes: Collect a soul pickup (kinds 0x18..0x1B worth 1, 10, 30, 100): mark it taken, play its sound when the cooldown allows, add the amount to the counter, stats and soul total

name: m3_ProbeDirF6510
notes: Probe from half a unit below the object towards an angle at a distance; 1 when the collision query reports a hit

name: m3_TblRestoreA9DC0
notes: Reset table settings (scales 1 and 2, selection -1, count 0) and restore ten 0x34-byte records from their saved copy

name: m3_MgrsHoldF8170
notes: Put the three stage managers into their hold state (flag updates, clear the +0xA4 counter)

name: m3_SndCmdEA2A0
notes: Run a sound command on bank A or B: restart a slot with 0 or its table value, or play it 3D at a source object; remember the mode per slot

name: m3_ArenaLightsE1170
notes: Set up the battle arena light units once: two states (hang on failure), load both light packs, allocate a kind-8 unit for each, clear eight light slots

name: m3_AiPickTarget114930
notes: Choose the AI target: locked keeps a live target or falls back to the player; otherwise a decoy within 40 units and no farther than the player, else the player; flag 0x1000 marks a change

name: m3_VoicePickEBF00
notes: Play a random voice line from a record (idle pair, hurt set or win set), counting the non-zero entries for the random pick

name: m3_TurnToA3170
notes: Turn towards a goal by at most |step| (the whole difference when smaller), wrap the yaw into -pi..pi, copy the rotation to the body

name: m3_BossIntroC04A0
notes: Boss intro phase step: phase 0 starts a 4-second timer and the arena object, phase 1 waits for the timer, phase 4 waits for a pad key; then state 0x25

name: m3_BossAimCBC00
notes: Set the boss aim point 25 units from the held object along a direction (towards home or from 0xCF2C0), 5 units lower; -1 without a target

name: m3_RingStart1029B0
notes: Start the ring effect around the hero: radius 20 at its position, twelve motion handles spread every 30 degrees from 90, each placed at the hero with its rotation

name: m3_StreamLoopE3C90
notes: Detect a stream loop: when not held and the last position is past the current plus half the loop span, count it and stop a kind-6 stream or re-mark tracks 1,2,5,6,7; clear cutscene flags; hangs on null

name: m3_TimerStartEA060
notes: Start a timed window from a record: clear eight slot flags, create its HUD text, set slot 0 with the start and window bounds and colour by kind, then set and show the HUD time

name: m3_GlowPulseA79E0
notes: Pulse an object glow: optional speed from the remaining fraction (4, 8 or 16), level bounces between 64 and 255, applied as a grey colour with alpha 128

name: m3_StageResetE3390
notes: Reset the stage: allocate the work block, detach and clear eight node pairs and five effects, reset sound/stats/menus, load the current entry cue or clear it, request combo mode 2

name: m3_AiTaunt11AD10
notes: AI taunt state: step 0 plays effect 0xCB and waits 70 frames, step 1 replaces its attached effect, step 2 goes to state 8 one time in four else waits 60 frames and goes to state 5

name: m3_TimerAddEA3F0
notes: Add a timed window: length len*0.03 seconds, +3 s on difficulty 0, -10 percent on difficulty 2; HUD text only without a timer object, else fill the first free of eight slots

name: m3_XfStackC75E0
notes: Spawn three stacked transforms at the object (scales 0.2, 0.25, 0.3, each lower than the last) and set each allocated one to mode 8

name: m3_MenuStepB3B60
notes: Menu step for a 2-int setting: slot from 0xDFD40 (hangs unless 0 and 11) or the mode; setting 10 opens with a cue, 11 confirms when ready, 20 clears and returns 0

name: m3_JumpMove113B20
notes: Move a jumping object: add its yaw-rotated local offset, apply gravity and 10 percent horizontal drag to the velocity and add it, then add and clear the one-frame push

name: m3_CamYawCCB30
notes: Free-look camera yaw: turn while the stick is off centre (direction from 0xCCA40, wrapped), adopt it as the rest yaw after 60 idle frame units

name: m3_VoiceHpEBAB0
notes: Random voice line for character slot 0: idle pair in mode 0, else the high-health set at half health or more, else the low-health set

name: m3_VoiceHpEBC30
notes: Same voice picker for character slot 1

name: m3_VoiceHpEBDB0
notes: Same voice picker for character slot 3

name: m3_VoiceHpEC080
notes: Same voice picker for character slot 7

name: m3_VoiceHpEC200
notes: Same voice picker for character slot 8

name: m3_CamTiltF4820
notes: Tilt the camera down: animate the tilt by pi/2 over 20 frame units (signal step 4 past -pi/2), or jump straight to -pi/2 when the node is active; output = view * base * tilt

name: m3_IdleLookFB870
notes: Idle look-around: turn 27 degrees towards the player past a +-27 degree delta, start anim 2 with a random 1.7..3.2 wait, and one time in seven trigger 0xFB580 when the manager cooldown is out

name: m3_HopFAF60
notes: Hop towards the player: rise by a growing hop speed, turn 3.5 degrees per frame unit, on landing finish with anim 0x12 or reset and play anim 9; once finished play anim 9 when the node is active

name: m3_ChaseStep105480
notes: Chase step: gap to the player minus the hero radius; step towards a player above -30 and stop near 28 units, else run 0x105330 and stop near 48; stop after 8 time units; otherwise count chase time

name: m3_XSlotClearC4B70
notes: Clear a 0xE0-byte transform slot: all float and integer fields set to zero

name: m3_ModelSwapCA0E0
notes: Swap the active model (second one when alt, copying its link), attach it as kind 0xB, make it current and bind/start/rewind the node player with part order 15..0

name: m3_CamProbeCAB90
notes: Probe around the camera point with radius 6 (or the event radius when larger); 1 on a hit, else the result of the line probe up to radius+2 above

name: m3_BossRiseBE8E0
notes: Boss rise phase: phase 0 flags the boss and starts the rise, phase 1 waits 18 time units, phase 2 waits for the timer and goes to state 0x1D or back to state 1

name: m3_SwapCheckD41D0
notes: Character swap check: refresh swap story bits; run a pending swap, or when nothing blocks and a swap button is hit reset the player, pick the target form and flag the swap

name: m3_CamFollowF5BB0
notes: Make an object the camera follow target (hangs on null): reset the camera, add its components, attach it, then with story bit 0x57 attach an effect and broadcast event 0x16, else set anim 0x10 on the target and both records

name: m3_RoomPlaceA3DB0
notes: Place a room object body: copy position and rotation, build its matrix from Z/Y/X rotation and uniform scale, update its floor and (flag 4 without 8) its pose; volatile flag copy keeps the two bit tests

name: m3_SoulDropA94B0
notes: Spawn a random soul pickup (kinds 0x18..0x1B) near the player: 0..110 units back, turned by up to +-179 degrees, 20 units lower

name: m3_GroupDown10F260
notes: Tear down a unit group (hangs on null): stop its cue list, release both held handles, destroy the component object, detach every active unit and the five active parts, reset and remove the camera components
